description: This file defines the SecurityManager class in Apache Spark, responsible for managing security configurations such as ACLs, authentication, encryption, and secret keys. It includes methods for setting and checking permissions, initializing secrets, and handling SSL options.

classes.name: SecurityManager
classes.description: Main class managing security features in Spark, including ACLs, authentication, SSL, and secret keys.

methods.name: getSSLOptions
methods.description: Returns SSL options for a specified module.

methods.name: setViewAcls
methods.description: Sets the view ACLs with default users and allowed users.

methods.name: setViewAclsGroups
methods.description: Sets the view ACL groups.

methods.name: getViewAcls
methods.description: Returns the view ACLs as a comma-separated string, or '*' if wildcard present.

methods.name: getViewAclsGroups
methods.description: Returns the view ACL groups as a comma-separated string, or '*' if wildcard present.

methods.name: setModifyAcls
methods.description: Sets the modify ACLs with default users and allowed users.

methods.name: setModifyAclsGroups
methods.description: Sets the modify ACL groups.

methods.name: getModifyAcls
methods.description: Returns the modify ACLs as a comma-separated string, or '*' if wildcard present.

methods.name: getModifyAclsGroups
methods.description: Returns the modify ACL groups as a comma-separated string, or '*' if wildcard present.

methods.name: setAdminAcls
methods.description: Sets the admin ACLs.

methods.name: setAdminAclsGroups
methods.description: Sets the admin ACL groups.

methods.name: setAcls
methods.description: Enables or disables ACLs.

methods.name: getIOEncryptionKey
methods.description: Returns the IO encryption key if set.

methods.name: aclsEnabled
methods.description: Checks if ACLs are enabled.

methods.name: checkAdminPermissions
methods.description: Checks if a user has admin permissions.

methods.name: checkUIViewPermissions
methods.description: Checks if a user has view permissions.

methods.name: checkModifyPermissions
methods.description: Checks if a user has modify permissions.

methods.name: isAuthenticationEnabled
methods.description: Checks if authentication is enabled.

methods.name: isEncryptionEnabled
methods.description: Checks if network encryption is enabled.

methods.name: isSslRpcEnabled
methods.description: Checks if RPC SSL is enabled.

methods.name: getRpcSSLOptions
methods.description: Returns SSL options for RPC.

methods.name: getSaslUser
methods.description: Returns the SASL user for authentication.

methods.name: getSecretKey
methods.description: Retrieves the secret key used for security.

methods.name: initializeAuth
methods.description: Initializes the authentication secret based on configuration and environment.

methods.name: secretKeyFromFile
methods.description: Reads and encodes secret key from a file if specified.

methods.name: isUserInACL
methods.description: Checks if a user or their groups are in the ACL.

methods.name: getEnvironmentForSslRpcPasswords
methods.description: Provides environment variables for SSL RPC passwords if SSL is enabled.
